notes:
Context: Scriptorium builds an IDE copilot used inside enterprise IDEs and a web-based editor. Primary asks: sub-100ms keystroke latency for inline completions, deterministic outputs for reproducible CI runs, and safe rollouts (canary + eval gates) to avoid regressions that break tests. POC scope: Dedicated GPU pool, pin model major+minor (e.g. rdx-2.1.3) with ability to pin tokenizer/kernels; support canary groups by team and automatic rollback when eval gate fails (unit-test failure rate increases >1.5%).

Customer quotes: "If a model update causes a single-line completion to change semantics and breaks our tests, it's game over for trust." — Head of ML Product.

Key technical notes (shorthand):
- Need streaming with immediate partial tokens (server push) and <60ms first-token latency from editor.
- Wants version pin metadata surfaced in logs and tracing (model.version, model.build_commit, quantization_profile).
- Eval harness: ~5k synthetic repo tests, existing flaky-test filter, requires reproducible random seeds and deterministic sampling for eval runs.
- Prefer canary runway: 24h canary then 72h broader canary with automatic rollback on regression.
- Wants persisted KV-cache across short restarts for snappy completions; ask legal about caching user code snippets vs. ephemeral cache.

Docs/shared artifacts: PRD + eval suite in Drive; Fireflies notes in links above; Jira tickets created for SAML (SEC-1190) and POC infra (INF-2042).

Next immediate actions: finalize NDA + SLA addendum (legal), exchange SAML metadata, schedule POC run kickoff (SE + infra), agree on exact eval pass thresholds and alerting hooks.
